messages:
Ana Rivera: Heads up - CloudScale wants marketplace listing, Redwood landing, and partner blog to go live simultaneously. Ops window?
Mike Chen: Ops prefers 09:00-11:00 UTC (EU/US overlap). @Priya ok for partner?
Priya (CloudScale): 09:00-11:00 UTC works. We need embargo lift at 08:45 UTC so press can schedule syndication.
Julie Park: Design needs hero + two screenshots by EOD tomorrow. Mike, where will assets land?
Mike Chen: Uploading to drive by 18:00 PT: https://drive.redwood.co/marketplace/cloudscale/assets
Tom Reilly: Short launch timeline:
- 07:30 UTC: infra preflight
- 08:15 UTC: internal huddle
- 08:30 UTC: CDN prewarm + DNS TTL reduce
- 08:45 UTC: embargo lift & PR distribution
- 09:00 UTC: publish landing + marketplace listing
- 09:05 UTC: smoke tests
SRE note: EdgeWorks (SI) needs test tenant + rotated API keys by 07:30 UTC. Tom will provision by 07:00 UTC.
Julie Park: I'll own blog finalization. @Priya please send a 30-40 word quote by 17:00 PT.
Mike Chen: Canonical routes: /cloudscale (landing) and /partners/cloudscale (marketplace). Tom will add UTM and redirects.
Tom Reilly: Will prewarm CDN and add redirect/UTM rules. Adding rollback snippet to runbook: 1) point /partners/cloudscale -> hold page, 2) call POST /v1/private/listings/{id}/revert, 3) notify #partners if >5% errors.
Mike Chen: Need launch-day coverage: 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM. Volunteers?
Julie Park: I'll cover comms 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Tom Reilly: I'll be infra primary 07:30-09:30 UTC, handing to Mike/Sree afterwards.
Ana Rivera: I'll post a final go/no-go at 06:00 UTC day-of. :rocket:
LaunchBot: Reminder set: "Pre-launch health check" 07:15 UTC -> #ops-bridge
Priya (CloudScale): Partner checklist green apart from quote. Standing by 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Mike Chen: Actions: Julie finalize blog + quote, Mike update runbook & calendar, Tom pre-provision + CDN prewarm, Priya deliver quote.
